Welcome to Voat! ...loading...
You're all welcome to visit /v/fatpeoplehelp and contribute as long as you can respect the context of the sub and keep it on topic. If you have something positive to add you're more than welcome to do so. If you need help yourself feel free to ask. Make yourself welcome. However, please, no shitlording and no plundering. Dear HAES/fat acceptance folks,
I can recognize that some people react positively to feeling good about their own bodies. This encourages some people to eat better and lose weight. This summarily makes them healthier. We're here to help you be healthier through diet and exercise. You don't have to live with excess cutaneous fat. You can fit into a single seat on a plane. You can shop at a regular clothing store. You can run a mile. You can lose weight and get healthier. If you want.
